guitar.guitaristsText: Steve Hackett / Mike Rutherford / Daryl Stuermer
guitar.evidence: Steve Hackett (early era) was known for Gibson Les Pauls; Mike Rutherford and touring guitarist Daryl Stuermer covered guitar in the Phil Collins era. No single guitar is iconic for the band's commercial 80s hits listed here.

tone.target: bright clean chorus arpeggio with gentle edge-of-breakup
tone.profile: bright clean chorus arpeggio with gentle edge-of-breakup
tone.summary: A classic 80s-inspired clean arpeggio tone, combining a light boost for definition, Chorus for width, and a UK clean amp model with subtle delay and room ambience.
